sources_considered.why: Direct randomized evidence of longer completion times for experienced maintainers using early-2025 AI tools.
Direct randomized evidence of shorter completion times for professional engineers on a complex enterprise task.
Read successfully. Its headline outcome is completed-task throughput, so the assessment uses the two studies directly measuring completion time.

evidence_items.explanation: The randomized trial covered 16 experienced developers completing 246 tasks in familiar mature projects using February–June 2025 tools. It directly supports a slowdown in this setting.

A randomized trial with 96 Google engineers on a complex enterprise task estimated about a 21% reduction in completion time. This contradicts the unconditional assertion that coding AI does not speed engineers up.

unresolved_gaps: These studies do not establish a representative industry-wide average effect.
The populations, tasks, tools and study years differ.
